09:57:53, 7 min 37 s: the envoy's first draft at welcome/.
09:58:26: run 1 of the invented visitors, on the front page as it was.
10:00:43: the designer sets the draft in the frame; the envoy takes the designer's two notes a minute later.
10:03:08, 12 min 52 s: run 2, on the first draft, naming the commit it read.

What a real reader would make of it, whether the rewrite is better, and Dinis's answer are not on record.
